title: Captain Vane's 'Smugglers' Road' favor names 'Rook, at the Rope Larder' and bearings twice point 'north-west' toward Rook from Camp Gallows, but following that direction through the deep-wood grid never surfaced a Rope Larder or a way to reach Rook.
